evidence: All five prompts (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual, each line 1) open 'the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000', matching task.toml name turing/colderwater-playground-devtools and app_context.md:3-4 'Name: Colderwater playground / URL: http://localhost:3000'; each embeds {app_context} and {criteria}. Credentials: app_context.md:10 'None. The app has no sign-in', consistent with instruction.md:5 'without signing in'; no prompt mentions accounts or sign-in, and the template's sign-in gate wording ('if the application has sign-in, that the accounts under Accounts can sign in') was replaced in every scored prompt by a workspace-with-code-editing-area gate. Screens/entities: app_context.md:14 lists title/filename fields, Undo, Redo, Format, Find, Replace, line/column readout, Run, Stop, New, Save, preview, console, library and revision history, all demanded by ui.md and overview.md; snippet entity (title, .js/.html filename, source, revisions) matches overview.md; health address /api/health matches integration.md. Cross-references resolve: constraints prompt:5 'storage clearing that the second criterion asks for' = cw_shared_saved_record (2nd criterion); app_context.md:29 three script uses map to cw_shared_saved_record/cw_save_reload_restart storage clearing, cw_restore_request_repeat_safe and cw_save_reload_restart replay, and cw_preview_isolation localStorage; functional prompt:33 'restart_app tool of the verifier MCP server' matches functional judge.toml mcp_servers name='verifier' and test.sh:193 APP_RESTART_HELPER export; only functional permits restart, others say 'Never restart the app'. Residue scan of tests/, instruction.md and instructions for CHANGE_ME/TODO/TBD/{{, other product names (HireOps, Rentora, etc.), login/password/admin/tenant/ticket, and alternative ports found nothing. Counterexample attempts: a model reading these prompts cannot be misled into signing in, visiting a nonexistent route or seeking a sibling's entities; a conforming app with differently worded controls is protected by 'Match controls by purpose and label'. Static source review only; no judge run was needed to evaluate prompt text accuracy for this row.
